$description: Only where a component needs a value of its own (data-model.md).

radius.$description: Today's dialogs. Off the radius scale on purpose until every dialog has moved to Dialog (FR-016); then it joins radius.scale.

layer.$description: Today's overlay layer. Menus that open from inside a dialog sit at 200; layer.overlay (300) would put them under it. Moves to the layer scale with the menus (batch 2).

size.$description: Today's dialog heading. Kept until every dialog uses Dialog, so old and new headings match (spec edge case: partial migration).

width.$description: The side peek (spec 007): wide enough for a page's text column, capped at half the window by the component so the view stays usable.

layer.$description: Above sticky headers (layer.sticky 50) so the view's headers pass under it; below dialogs (dialog.layer 100) and menus (layer.dropdown 200), because both open from inside the peek and must draw over it.

width.$description: The centre peek (spec 007): room for a page's text column with its margins, capped by the window.

layer.$description: The same layer as the side peek, for the same reason: dialogs and menus opened from the page inside it must draw over it.

button.$description: The one button (spec 020, R2). Every rule in ui/Button.css reads one of these or a colour role (spec 019); a new look is a new property value with its tokens, never a class.

sm.$description: Small: toolbars and dense rows. Today's .btn-sm was about 26px; 28 is still small and a better pointer target (Claude's default, spec 020 R2).

md.$description: Medium lines up with inputs and selects (control.height); today's .btn was 34px.

xs.$description: Extra small: an action drawn inside a table cell (ui/CellAction, spec 026). The approved mockup's 24px fits a 34px row without growing it.

touch.$description: xs on a touch screen that cannot hover (spec 026): big enough for a thumb inside a phone's row; CellAction adds the 44px tap area around it.

gap.$description: Between an icon and the label.

inset.$description: The gap between a ToggleGroup's hairline frame and its items (spec 020, R6). The frame's radius is the button radius plus this, so the inner and outer corners stay concentric.

radius.$description: One radius for every button, every emphasis and size (owner, spec 020). 6px is Claude's default: between today's 4px small, 8px medium and the pill.

width.$description: The hairline of medium emphasis; the other emphases keep it transparent so every button is the same size.

weight.$description: One weight for every emphasis; high stands out by its fill (Claude's default).

height.$description: Inputs and selects line up with a medium button.

radius.$description: Input variant="cell" (spec 026): the button's 6px corners, as in the approved mockup.

editor.$description: BlockNote's Mantine theme (FR-011). Its menus read --bn-* custom properties on .bn-container; set from these, the slash menu, the formatting bar and their dropdowns are the same panel as every other menu and follow the tokens. Written under [data-theme], which outranks BlockNote's own [data-color-scheme] rules.

background.$description: BlockNote uses its tooltip pair for three things at once: the icon box beside each slash-menu entry, the shortcut badge and the real tooltip. Ink here turned the slash menu into a column of black squares, so the pair stays quiet; theme.css gives the real tooltip its ink on its own.

side-menu.$description: The + and drag handle beside a hovered block (#811, owner chose option B from a picture, 2026-11-20). BlockNote draws each as a 24×24 button with a 22px icon in a pale grey (1.49:1 on the light page); narrower, with the muted text colour, it stays as tall as a line of text and so as easy to grab.

icon.$description: Set on the two icons only (styles.css), not as BlockNote's --bn-colors-side-menu, which also colours the empty-line placeholder, the nesting guides and the table handles.

drop-line.$description: Where a dragged block will land (#809). BlockNote's default is a fixed #ddeeff, 1.13:1 on the light page: there, but unseen, which made dragging feel stuck. Its colour is --color-focus, read directly (Editor.tsx), because a component token aliasing a themed role is flattened to the light value.

height.$description: A chart's height setting (spec 004, FR-024). Medium fits a chart beside text without scrolling; extra large is for a chart that is the page.

width.$description: ui/Popover's panel (spec 004, the chart settings): Notion's panel is about this wide, room for a labelled dropdown and a row of five kind buttons. Capped at the window by the component.

layer.$description: Above dialogs (dialog.layer 100) and the peeks (side-panel.layer 90), so a chart's settings open over a chart shown in a peek; below menus (layer.dropdown 200), because a Select inside the popover opens its list over it.

icon-size.$description: The one size of every menu icon (spec 010, research R7). Menus used to mix 15 and 16 px; ui/Menu draws every item's icon at this size so a function's icon looks the same in every menu.

cell-action.$description: ui/CellAction (spec 026): a small button at a table cell's end, over the cell's text.

inset.$description: Between the button and the cell's right edge.

tap.$description: The tap area round the button on a touch screen (WCAG 2.5.5).
